acs.text_first_line: AC1 The notice read declares the dispatch and proof-of-delivery fields
AC2 The INT-14 file element fixes the record set, the feed version, the business date and the batch status
AC3 LOV-DELIVERY and LOV-SENT-TYPE are the only delivery list elements
AC4 The digest of a repeated proof-of-delivery row is idempotent
AC5 The two event envelopes carry IDs and facts only
AC6 dispatch_file_id is a reference to outbound_item of rwb-integration
AC7 The four consumed rows carry their owner, the budget and the degraded shape
AC8 The four fakes answer the document and the drift test fails the build
